organizingIdeas.title: Matter
organizingIdeas.statement: Understandings of the physical world are deepened by investigating matter and energy.

organizingIdeas.title: Earth Systems
organizingIdeas.statement: Understandings of the living world, Earth, and space are deepened by investigating natural systems and their interactions.

knowledge.text: The responsibility to care for environments is shared by all people and is fulfilled by showing respect for and protecting all aspects of nature.

organizingIdeas.title: Living Systems
organizingIdeas.statement: Understandings of the living world, Earth, and space are deepened by investigating natural systems and their interactions.

guidingQuestions.question: How do plants and animals survive?

outcomes.outcome: Students investigate and examine needs of plants and animals.

Plants usually cannot move from place to place.
Animals are living things that can grow and that need to find food.

Plants and animals exist in all shapes and sizes.
Humans are part of nature and are classified as animals.

understanding.text: Plants and animals share similarities and have differences.
